Registration onto the booking system would be required, with sign off by staff on Terms of Use, Driver Declaration. The system should add bookings made automatically into staff calendars and data should be collated on trips, including CO2 savings. A few scenarios: • A staff member takes the bus/LUAS into work at County Hall. They borrow a staff EV from the Mobility Hub to visit a site across the city for an in-person meeting during the working day. • A staff member walks into work at County Hall. They borrow a staff e-bike from the Mobility Hub to visit a site within the County for an in-person work event. • Several staff members book one EV from the Mobility Hub, to travel together to a working meeting in a neighbouring County, returning the EV back to County Hall the same day. Interested parties must supply contact details and an overview of their offering for the effective delivery of this solution. The Council will schedule demonstration meetings with potential suppliers to hear about their offerings and provide more details.
